one_line_thesis: Nasdaq Inc. is a global croupier (exchange + FinTech SaaS) with durable toll economics but cyclical transaction mix; at $86.66 synthesis return 9.26%/yr supports watch until price approaches $58–65 for core-return hurdle.

deep_dive.executive_summary: Nasdaq Inc. is a toll collector on global capital-markets activity: exchange trading, clearing, index and data subscriptions, and financial-technology SaaS with minimal principal risk. FY2025 filings confirm $5,249 million net revenue less transaction expenses, $2,331 million operating income, and $12,227 million stockholders' equity; Q1 2026 accelerated on strong Market Services volumes and $517 million Financial Technology revenue (+20% year over year). At $86.66 per share (Yahoo Finance, 2026-06-11), we expect about 9.26% per year over 7 years on $3.44 mid-cycle free cash flow per share ...
